title: CluesEvent
description:
One event of a Clues stream: `clues_started`, then the people in `clues` pages, then
exactly one of `done`, `no_enrichment`, `invalid_mappings` or `source_unavailable`, which
ends the stream.

contract_version.description: The version of the contract it speaks, [`CONTRACT_VERSION`](crate::CONTRACT_VERSION).

oneOf.description:
A page of at most 1,000 people, fewer once their JSON passes 1 MiB, in entity order.
Every entity of the item's type the tables create is on one page, with or without a
clue.

conflicting.description: People with a clue left out because it holds two values.

entities.description: The people sent: every entity of the item's type the tables create.

no_clue.description: People left with no clue to look them up by.

no_name.description: People without a name: none of the type's `names` props has a value.

shared.description: People with a clue value left out because another entity holds it too.

oneOf.description: The mappings have no `[enrichments]` item: nobody is looked up.

The mappings don't fit the ontology or the sources, as Ingest's `invalid_mappings`:
a retry fails the same way.

errors.description: Every problem, each naming its mapping.

oneOf.description: A source couldn't be read; a retry may succeed.

CluedEntity.description:
One person a load could look up: the clues the load's identifier index holds for them, and
the name a profile found by them must give (as `clue_name`) to bind them.

email.description:
The work email, normalized as an `email` identifier: what the profile's `clue_email`
must be. Absent when the person has none, shares it or has two.

entity.description: The entity, by type and key: `Person[sc_17]`.

linkedin_url.description:
The LinkedIn URL as the person's prop holds it, normalized as an `exact` identifier:
what the profile's `clue_linkedin_url` must be. Absent as `email` is.

name.description:
The person's name as the load checks it: the first value each of the type's `names`
props was given, in `names` order, joined by spaces. A profile binds the person only
when its `clue_name` is exactly this. Absent when none has a value.
